race.comment: CARBONARA (8) gets the nod on the strength of her latest Gold Coast third, where she was beaten 1.5L in a CL2 after giving them something to chase. Her Eagle Farm failure two back is a clear blemish, but she has been competitive often enough over the past 12 months and the apprentice claim helps bring her right into this. NINJITZOU (10) is the immediate danger after a strong second-up platform, beaten just under a length at Ipswich in a CL4 after being steadied midrace. He also has a strong record at this venue and handles wet ground well enough to be trusted. MISS FUNNY HONEY (1) comes off a BM65 win at this track on heavy ground and has the proven wet-track profile to offset the quick back-up, though the car park draw will test her. SIR MAURICE (2) has placed at both recent runs, gets a 2kg claim, and brings reliable track, distance and wet-ground profiles, even if his winning strike rate keeps him just behind the top few.
